prompt_inputs.goal: optimize athletic performance and recovery for soccer match

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers full day (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks) with realistic portion sizes
All meals are vegetarian with adequate protein sources (legumes, tofu, dairy, nuts, seeds) to support athletic performance
Plan is compact and concise (1 day format, minimal elaboration)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific dietary constraint (vegetarian soccer player) requiring alternative protein sources while meeting athletic performance needs

prompt_inputs.goal: Prepare for marathon race day with optimal carbohydrate loading and energy timing around 2-hour morning training run

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers exactly 1 day with 4-5 meals/snacks
Includes high carbohydrate intake (60-70% of calories) appropriate for endurance athlete
Pre-training meal provided 2-3 hours before morning run and post-training recovery meal within 30-60 minutes
All meals respect vegetarian and nut-free restrictions
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-intensity endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and specific timing around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize strength and power output with optimal recovery between morning and evening training sessions

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans full 24 hours with at least 3 meals and 2 snacks strategically timed around training windows
Protein distributed across all eating occasions (minimum 25g per meal/snack) totaling approximately 1.6-2.0g per kg bodyweight
Includes specific recovery nutrition within 2 hours post-training with carbohydrates and protein for glycogen replenishment
All meals and snacks are practical, compact descriptions suitable for a single day reference guide
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) emphasizing protein distribution and recovery nutrition across multiple training windows
